changelog:
Initial release of ad-creative skill for scalable, high-performing ad copy generation and iteration.

- Supports generating and iterating ad creative (headlines, descriptions, primary text) for major paid ad platforms (Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, Twitter/X).
- Provides step-by-step guidance: gather context, define angles, generate and validate variations, and organize output for upload.
- Incorporates platform-specific specs (character limits, requirements) and outlines creative best practices.
- Allows analysis of performance data to optimize and scale winning ad creative.
- Includes workflow and references for AI-driven ad visual generation (images, video, audio) at scale.
